app_unit_base.description: Base for unit display: 1024 for KiB/MiB/GiB (binary), 1000 for KB/MB/GB (decimal)

chat_timestamp.description: Format string for chat message timestamps

minimize_to_tray.description: Minimize to tray instead of taskbar

show_hidden_message_window.description: Show hidden message window on incoming PM

show_unread_messages_alert.description: Alert (flash tray icon) on unread messages

chat_background_color.description: HTML hex color for chat background

chat_dbl_click_action.description: Double-click action: 0=insert nick, 1=get file list, 2=private message

chat_mdl_click_action.description: Middle-click action: 0=insert nick, 1=get file list, 2=private message

chat_enable_spell_check.description: Enable spell checking in chat (requires aspell support)

hubframe_redirect_pm_to_main_chat.description: Redirect private messages to main chat: 0=off, 1=on

shortcuts.description: List of keyboard shortcuts as name-value pairs. Each entry maps shortcut_name to shortcut_key_combination string (e.g., {'Ctrl+O': 'Ctrl+O', ...}).

search_auto_search_on_type.description: Automatically start search as user types
